title: Adult Tic Disorders Registry
summary: The purpose of this study is to develop the adult tic disorders registry in order to characterize the relationship between tic severity and tic-related impairment in women compared to men with tic disorders.

interventions.name: QOL to be completed by the participant

criteria:
Inclusion criteria :

1. Age \>18 years
2. Patients with Tic disorders
3. Given the non-opposition

Non Inclusion criteria

1. No affiliation to a French health social insurance
2. Significant congenital disorders that may affect understanding of assessments
3. Patients under guardianship or curatorship
